including or compiling content in a book, album, or collection

notes:
FORMS:
{収|しゅう} (collect, gather) + {録|ろく} (record) → collect and record
{収録|しゅうろく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to record, to include)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧{収録|しゅうろく} (public recording with audience)
- {収録|しゅうろく}⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ (recorded/included track)
- {収録|しゅうろく}{語数|ごすう} (number of entries - for dictionaries)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{録画|ろくが}→録画：04441_rokuga⟧ (video recording)
- ⟦{録音|ろくおん}→録音：05107_rokuon⟧ (audio recording)
- ⟦{生放送|なまほうそう}→生放送：08172_namahousou⟧ (live broadcast - opposite)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{収録|しゅうろく} often implies recording for later broadcast (pre-recorded), as opposed to ⟦{生放送|なまほうそう}→生放送：08172_namahousou⟧ (live). For music, {収録|しゅうろく} implies the song is included on an album or compilation.
